I have enrolled myself in the course of System Commands (se2001) of diploma in programming in the term of Jan 2026.

The week 1 content have been released in the portal along with GrPAs od respective week but I am unable to code in those GrPAs and the test run is also not working and seems to run for a long time without producung any output.

Screenshot 2026-02-11 1337352775×1628 279 KB

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked: Someone also faced same issue, you can check this post. Using Brave browser fixed it. Link to the post.
